'''Norma G. Sanchez''' is an Argentinian and French [[physicist]] with research expertise in [[theoretical physics]], [[gravity]], [[cosmology]], [[particle physics]], [[high-energy physics]] and [[quantum field]] and [[Quantum field theory|quantum theory]]. She is emeritus Professor of Physics and Director of Research at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (CNRS), [[Paris Observatory]] and [[Paris Sciences et Lettres University|PSL Sorbonne University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=  Norma Graciela SANCHEZ
|url=http://aramis.obspm.fr/~sanchez/|publisher=NUGA}}</ref>

Her work is on [[black holes]], [[Hawking radiation]], [[string theory]] in gravity and cosmology, effective inflation theory vs WMAP observations, keV dark matter and galaxy structure and theoretical models relating gravity and quantum physics. She is the founder and director of the International School Daniel Chalonge - Hector de Vega, inaugurated in the fall of 1991 by Nobel physicist [[Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar|S. Chandrasekhar]].<ref>{{cite web |title=La Dra. Norma Sánchez, pionera en física cuántica, visitó la UTN Pacheco y brindó una conferencia magistral |url=https://www.frgp.utn.edu.ar/novedades/detalle/881 |website=UTN FRGP |language=en}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Born in the city of [[Ensenada, Buenos Aires|Ensenada]], Buenos Aires, Argentina, her father Antonio Luis Sanchez de Martino worked in the chemistry-physics of Oil Industry, [[YPF]], and her mother Norma Iris Piccoli di Tores in education and astronomy, Sanchez followed primary studies at the National School Hypolite Bouchard, pre-university studies at the School Normal National of girls N°1 Miss Mary O. Graham in the city of La Plata and completed her [[M.Sc.]] in [[Theoretical Physics]] at the Faculty of Exact Sciences, [[National University of La Plata]], Argentina, on December 21, 1973.{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}

She holds a Ph.D. in physics from the Faculty of Exact Sciences, National University of La Plata, Argentina, received in 1976 for the thesis ''Wave Scattering Theory by a Black-Hole'' and is a State Doctor in Physics, [[University of Paris]], 1979 with a thesis ''On the Physics of Fields and the Geometry of Space-Time''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Norma G. Sanchez|url=https://data.bnf.fr/fr/12373784/norma_graciela_sanchez/ | website=Bibliothèque Nationale de France}}</ref>

The film ''La Dama de la Ciencia'' (''The Lady of Science'') documents her life in Paris and Ensenada.<ref>{{cite web |title=Estrenan "La dama de la ciencia", la fascinante historia de la física Norma Sánchez |url=https://www.0221.com.ar/nota/2020-5-25-11-2-0-estrenan-la-dama-de-la-ciencia-la-fascinante-historia-de-la-fisica-norma-sanchez |website=0221 |language=es-PA |date=25 May 2020}}</ref>

==Research and career==
From 1973 to 1975, Sanchez was a teaching assistant at the [[National University of La Plata]], Faculty of Exact Sciences and a researcher at the [[CONICET|Council of Scientific Argentinian Research]] (CONICET), Institute of Astronomy and Space Science (IAFE), UBA campus, Buenos Aires.<ref>{{cite web |title=Norma Sánchez, una de las mentes científicas |url=https://www.eldia.com/nota/2023-3-2-3-55-9-norma-sanchez-una-de-las-mentes-cientificas-mas-brillantes-del-mundo-la-ciudad |website=El Día |language=es}}</ref>

In 1976, she joined the [[French National Center for Scientific Research]] (CNRS), as a researcher in [[theoretical physics]], and is presently Research Director at CNRS.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kiernan |first1=Sergio |title=De Ensenada a tocar las estrellas {{!}} Una charla con Norma Sánchez, la notable astrofísica argentina |url=https://www.pagina12.com.ar/543761-de-ensenada-a-tocar-las-estrellas |website=PAGINA12 |language=es |date=26 April 2023}}</ref> Between 1986 and 1987 Sanchez has a visiting appointment at [[CERN]] – Theory Division, Geneva, Switzerland and in 11988 at [[NORDITA]] – Niels Bohr Institute, Copenhagen, Denmark.{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}

Early in her career, Sanchez worked on Wave Scattering and Absorption Theory by [[Black holes]] and a new approach to [[Quantum Field Theory]] in accelerated frames and curved space-times.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sánchez |first1=Norma |title=Wave scattering theory and the absorption problem for a black hole |journal=Physical Review D |date=15 August 1977 |volume=16 |issue=4 |pages=937–945 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevD.16.937 |bibcode=1977PhRvD..16..937S |url=https://journals.aps.org/prd/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevD.16.937}}</ref> Sanchez then began her lifelong collaboration with Hector de Vega, working on new approaches to [[string theory]] in [[gravity]], [[cosmology]] and [[black holes]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Sanchez |first1=Norma G. |title=Quantum trans-Planckian physics inside black holes and its spectrum |journal=Physical Review D |date=20 June 2023 |volume=107 |issue=12 |article-number=126018 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevD.107.126018 |url=https://journals.aps.org/prd/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevD.107.126018|arxiv=2404.05077 |bibcode=2023PhRvD.107l6018S }}</ref> Their work continued on dark matter models, keV dark matter in particular ([[Warm dark matter|WDM]]), large scale structure, [[galaxy formation]] and [[particle physics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Un nouveau modèle pour décrire la structure des galaxies |url=https://www.observatoiredeparis.psl.eu/un-nouveau-modele-pour.html?lang=en |website=Observatoire de Paris - PSL - Centre de recherche en astronomie et astrophysique |language=en |date=26 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=De Sartre a Cortázar: la historia recuperada por la Dra. Norma Sánchez |url=https://universidadeshoy.com.ar/nota/77406/de-sartre-a-cortazar-la-historia-recuperada-por-la-dra-norma-sanchez/ |website=Universidades Hoy |language=es-ES}}</ref>
